items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher Henderson and that group, Duke Ellington around the New York area then... started I think by Duke and Fletcher Henderson

ctx.x: We can verify that easily because Budd Johnson is here with us.
Right. But Jimmy left to go with Goodman later on, as I recall. Jimmy Mundy became the mainstay of the Benny Goodman arranging staff, along with Fletcher Henderson and Edgar Sampson.
